intro.heading: Building systems that fit each organization's real needs.
intro.body1: MeU Solutions is a software development and technology solutions company focused on building systems that fit the practical needs of each organization. From consulting, requirement analysis and system development to testing, deployment and operations support, MeU walks alongside businesses through every step of their digital transformation.
intro.body2: With a team experienced in software development and applied technologies such as AI, Cloud Computing and Big Data, MeU Solutions aims to create practical technology products that streamline processes, improve operational efficiency and open up new opportunities for growth.

vision.heading: The direction behind every project.
vision.visionBody: Applying technology to build a community of excellence.
vision.missionBody: Turning your dream of digital solutions into reality.

partners.heading: 100+ partners across industries, growing together through technology.
partners.body1: MeU Solutions has partnered with more than 100 businesses, organizations and partners of all sizes, operating across many fields such as commerce, retail, F&B, logistics, education, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, associations and service industries.
partners.body2: Every partner brings a unique challenge and set of requirements. Through each collaboration, MeU keeps accumulating experience, developing flexible solutions and building systems that fit each operating model.
partners.closing: 100+ partners is not just a number — it is a journey of collaboration, connection and practical technology value created together.

join.heading: Teammates are a vital part of MeU Solutions' journey.
join.body: MeU values professional expertise, creative thinking and attitude at work. We are looking for teammates with a learning mindset, initiative and the desire to build technology solutions with real-world value together.
join.quote: “We hire talented teammates — and we end partnerships over attitude.”

leadership.heading: The people who founded and lead MeU.
leadership.bio1: Having overcome many challenges in the technology industry, Mr. Tran Thanh Tuyen nurtured an intense passion for software testing and technology solutions. With a spirit of continuous learning, innovation and the ambition to deliver high-quality software development services, he founded MeU Solutions in 2016.
leadership.bio2: Under his leadership together with a dedicated team of experts, MeU Solutions grew rapidly to become one of the pioneering companies in software development, software testing and technology consulting in Vietnam.
leadership.bio3: His passion and strategic vision are a great source of inspiration — proof that with persistence and continuous effort, anyone can create value and success in the technology field.
leadership.history1: Software Engineer, CSC Vietnam Co., Ltd.
leadership.history2: Senior Manager / Senior Software Engineer, KMS Technology Co., Ltd., Vietnam
leadership.history3: M.Sc. in Engineering, Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (2009)
leadership.history5: Startup advisory expert, FPT University HCMC branch
leadership.history6: Lecturer at Saigon International University (SIU), HUTECH University

origin.heading: From frustration to focus.
origin.summary: We started as engineers and consultants frustrated by the gap between strategy and execution.
origin.body: Too many transformation initiatives produced slides instead of working systems. Too many software projects lost the connection to the operational result they were supposed to deliver. We built MeU to close that gap.

mission.heading: Technology with business intent.
mission.summary: We believe technology earns its place when it removes friction, unlocks growth or makes better decisions possible.
mission.body: Every engagement starts from the outcome you need. We work backward from there to the systems, processes and people that make it real.
